registry.behavior: SessionTable.bindFromJson accepts an unknown scope, validates against the shared revisionScopeSchema and binds only on successful parse; invalid input throws without consuming a binding number or changing state.

assignment.goal: Add SessionTable.bindFromJson(sessionId: string | null, scope: unknown): SessionBinding and focused unit tests in Reviews src/tests/sessions.test.ts.
assignment.approach: In Reviews src/session.ts import revisionScopeSchema from the existing contracts vocabulary exposure, add the method to SessionTable and its createSessionTable result. Parse before mutating, then delegate to bind with the parsed scope to retain copying/freezing and counter semantics. In sessions.test.ts cover accepted all and latest scopes (including null session id), rejection of malformed discriminants, non-positive/non-integer counts and non-object inputs, unchanged bindings on rejection, and unchanged counter demonstrated by the next successful bind. Do not change MCP/router, contracts, module declarations or child modules.

assignment.completionEvidence: The new method has the requested exact signature and validates unknown scope via the shared revisionScopeSchema before any state change; valid input produces the same frozen copied binding and boundAt sequence as bind, while invalid input throws and preserves existing/default binding and the next boundAt value.
